sentences.en: I've always wondered what it'd be like to have siblings.
sentences.zh: 我一直很好奇有兄弟姐妹是什么样的感觉。

sentences.en: "Do you have any siblings?" "No, I'm an only child."
sentences.zh: “你有兄弟姐妹吗？”“没有，我是独生子女。”

sentences.en: The youngest siblings are in general the most beautiful ones.
sentences.zh: 通常来说，最小的兄弟姐妹是最漂亮的。

senses.zh: 兄弟，姐妹,生同科，同属,人氏族成员
